listing.name: Order from the Boss
listing.summary: Allows the player to force allies to perform simple actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missile weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Allows the player to force allies to perform simple actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missile weapons.

description:
A simple mod to solve my problem seeing an ally misses another timing to vent or torpedo enemy. This mod allows you to force allies to do simple things like venting / use shipsystem / toggle shield / fire missile weapons.

To use: Hold R and move mouse over an ally as the target, press Q switch target if many modules overlapping.

Download at github link

https://github.com/a111164i/Order-from-the-Boss/releases/download/0.98a/Order.from.the.Boss.EN.zip

.

aiDescription: Allows the player to force allies to perform simple actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missile weapons. The player holds R and hovers the mouse over an ally to target them, then presses Q to switch between overlapping modules. Designed to help prevent allies from missing critical timing during combat.
